scope: bootstrap-v2 custom Citus patch production integration audit
contract: A custom Citus patch is production-ready only after the patch artifact exists, is listed in patches/series, passes patches-check, and has a measured non-scaffold gate result at the declared result_path.

patches.title: hashtable on planner hotpath
required_evidence: patch artifact exists under patches/ and is listed in patches/series
make -f Makefile.ai-blaise patches-check applies or reverse-applies it cleanly
measured router planner hot-path benchmark result from a real Citus build
production readiness audit entry with VM or CI run identity
patches.fail_closed_notes: No scaffold, skipped, missing, or prose-only benchmark result can promote this patch.

patches.title: fast-path router skip coordinator round-trip
required_evidence: patch artifact exists under patches/ and is listed in patches/series
make -f Makefile.ai-blaise patches-check applies or reverse-applies it cleanly
measured single-shard router probe result from a real Citus build
production readiness audit entry with pool or companion command path
patches.fail_closed_notes: A quick-mode scaffold or missing Postgres endpoint is not evidence for coordinator-skip behavior.

patches.title: citus clock cohabit pg_cron
required_evidence: patch artifact exists under patches/ and is listed in patches/series
make -f Makefile.ai-blaise patches-check applies or reverse-applies it cleanly
real cohabitation smoke boots Citus and pg_cron together
production readiness audit records image identity and zero registration conflicts
patches.fail_closed_notes: A doc-only compatibility claim cannot promote this patch without a real boot result.

patches.title: cohabit-extensions detection API
required_evidence: patch artifact exists under patches/ and is listed in patches/series
make -f Makefile.ai-blaise patches-check applies or reverse-applies it cleanly
companion detection matrix covers TimescaleDB, pg_cron, and pg_partman
production readiness audit records measured detection output
patches.fail_closed_notes: Static allowlist docs are not enough; the detection matrix must be measured.
